hero.subtitle: Configure TLS-encrypted LDAP (port 636) for production AD authentication.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: LDAPS wraps LDAP in TLS. Install a valid certificate on your DC or import the CA chain on the API host. Set AD_LDAP_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=false only for dev/self-signed certs.

config.title: Environment
config.description: Use ldaps://dc.example.com:636 as AD_LDAP_URL. Open port 636 from the API to the DC.
